About this Store Berkeley At Trader Joe's in Berkeley , we see ourselves as your neighborhood grocery store. Step inside and you'll find unconventional and interesting products in the Trader Joe's label like Mandarin Orange Chicken and Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate, as well as everyday basics like milk, eggs, meat, bakery items, and fresh produce. We are a good source for great cheese, and we offer a vibrant selection of fresh flowers. Most importantly, we offer all of our delicious, quality products at the very best prices. We’re happy to be part of your community, and proud to offer you unique products and an exceptional shopping experience, every day. WATCH THE VIDEO Believe-Eat-Or-Not Recipes So. Good. Trader Joe’s Organic Earl Grey Tea is deceptively simple. It’s an Organic blend of bold, full-bodied black Tea from South India, balanced with an invigorating, floral black Tea from Africa combined with oil from organic Italian Bergamot oranges. The Bergamot lends a citrusy, heady aroma (think of Bergamot as the Meyer lemon's warm, spiced cousin) and brightens the flavor of its black Tea counterparts. It makes a fine cuppa, especially with a splash of milk, as well as a particularly aromatic glaze, ideal for zhuzhing up an array of baked goods. Teatime, anyone? Serves 12 Time 20 mins - 30 mins Yum! Though it’s technically a Cottage Pie (as it’s made with beef instead of lamb) our umami-rich Shepherd’s Pie recipe combines Ground Beef and Sliced Shiitake Mushrooms with Trader Joe’s Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend for super-savory, dynamic flavor. But the real secret to this Shepherd's Pie’s success? Trader Joe’s Mashed Potatoes! No peeling. No mashing. No, really! Our frozen Mashed Potatoes are prepped and impeccably seasoned (with just milk, butter, and salt) for your time-saving convenience. Serves 6-8Time 1 h 5 mins Delish! The superb snack-ability of Trader Joe’s Soft Pretzel Stick cannot be denied. It has a pleasantly chewy, soft crumb with a classic dark-brown-pretzel exterior, and its bun shape makes it ideal for cutting into slices or cubes for dunking into an array of dips. Paired with your favorite Trader Joe’s mustard? Of course. Slathered with a swoop of soft butter? Definitely. Served alongside a bowl of warm beer cheese that’s ready in 10 minutes? You bet!
